programme.title: 7 Up: The Story
programme.desc: In 1964, ITV broadcast a film about fourteen seven-year-olds. It became the longest running documentary series ever. Those children are now seventy. 7 Up set out to prove that Britain was divided by the class system - that these children's futures had been decided by the street they were born on. The production team had three weeks to find them. They went to some of the poorest parts of the country and some of the most privileged, and came back with ten boys and four girls. The series became one of British television's most remarkable social experiments, the cameras dipping into their lives every seven years. Children from different parts of the class system who have now become friends. This special programme looks at the year 7 Up was made, the idea behind it, and what they hoped for in a Britain about to change around them.

Wheldon tries to uncover meanings and motivations in the artist's work, but Moore freely admits that he doesn't want to examine himself too thoroughly in case it inhibits his ability to create. "I hate talking about my work", said Moore. "You can't explain a year's work in five minutes; and in any case all you do is to release your tensions and talk them away."

programme.title: 7 Up: The Story
programme.desc: In 1964, ITV broadcast a film about fourteen seven-year-olds. It became the longest running documentary series ever. Those children are now seventy. 7 Up set out to prove that Britain was divided by the class system - that these children's futures had been decided by the street they were born on. The production team had three weeks to find them. They went to some of the poorest parts of the country and some of the most privileged, and came back with ten boys and four girls. The series became one of British television's most remarkable social experiments, the cameras dipping into their lives every seven years. Children from different parts of the class system who have now become friends. This special programme looks at the year 7 Up was made, the idea behind it, and what they hoped for in a Britain about to change around them.

Faced with a tight budget, Beane must reinvent his team by outsmarting the richer ball clubs. Joining forces with Ivy League graduate Peter Brand, Beane prepares to challenge old-school traditions. He recruits bargain-bin players whom the scouts have labelled as flawed, but have game-winning potential.

programme.title: Chicago
programme.desc: Roxy Hart is sent to prison for shooting her lying lover. In prison, she meets tabloid darling and headline singer, Velma Kelly, who is also in for a double murder. With the help of a slick Chicago lawyer, she learns to play the media game and vies for the valuable press attention that will get her out of jail.

programme.title: Catch Me if You Can
programme.desc: Based on a true-crime story about teenage con man Frank Abagnale Jr, who cashed fake cheques worth over $2.5 million while disguised as a pilot, a doctor and a lawyer, all the while chased by an FBI agent who is determined to catch him.

programme.title: Ghostbusters
programme.desc: Supernatural comedy about three New York parapsychology professors who decide to set up a ghost-catching agency. Soon a storm of malevolent spirits threatens to destroy the city, and the mysterious contents of a woman's fridge suggest a paranormal Armageddon.

programme.title: I Know What You Did Last Summer
programme.desc: When five friends cause a deadly car accident, they cover up their involvement and keep it a secret rather than face the consequences. One year later, they find themselves stalked by a mysterious killer who knows what they did last summer.

programme.title: Pacific Rim
programme.desc: A ragtag band of humans bands together in the year 2025 to fight legions of monstrous creatures rising from the sea.

programme.title: Brightburn
programme.desc: After a difficult struggle with fertility, Tori Breyer's dreams of motherhood come true with the arrival of a mysterious baby boy. Brandon appears to be everything Tori and her husband, Kyle, ever wanted - bright, talented and curious about the world. But as Brandon nears puberty, powerful darkness manifests within him, and Tori becomes consumed by terrible doubts about her son. Once Brandon begins to act on his twisted urges, those closest to him find themselves in grave danger.

programme.title: Event Horizon
programme.desc: After disappearing for seven years, revolutionary spaceship Event Horizon is rediscovered. The team of scientists sent to investigate find that the entire crew is dead, and a terrifying, malevolent presence is lurking on board.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn 3: The Hangman's Daughter
programme.desc: Writer Ambrose Bierce and his fellow travellers converge upon a vampire-infested cantina in 1914 Mexico.

programme.title: 28 Years Later: The Bone Temple
programme.desc: Dr Kelson makes a discovery that could change the world, while Spike's encounter with cult leader Jimmy Crystal becomes a nightmare he can't escape.

programme.title: Mad Max Beyond Thunderdome
programme.desc: Set in a lawless, post-apocalyptic wilderness. To retrieve his camel train, hero Max enters the seedy, savage, rough-hewn precincts of Bartertown. Forced to fight for his possessions, he breaks the only rule of the city and is banished. In the desert, he is rescued by a tribe of feral children who see him as a prophesied saviour.

programme.title: The Core
programme.desc: The world is struck by inexplicable phenomena - Rome's Colosseum explodes, London's pigeons go berserk - until it becomes apparent that the planet's core has stopped moving, causing electro-magnetic mayhem. The only hope lies in a crack team of scientists burrowing to the core and re-starting earth's engine, but is the disaster natural or is there a more sinister explanation?

programme.title: Van Helsing
programme.desc: Van Helsing, the fabled 19th century monster hunter who travels to distant and dangerous lands in his quest to vanquish evil, must battle classic villains Dracula, Frankenstein's monster and the Wolf Man.

programme.title: Men in Black: International
programme.desc: The Men in Black have expanded to cover the globe, but so have the villains of the universe. When aliens that can take the form of any human arrive on Earth, H and M embark on a globe-trotting adventure to save the agency -- and ultimately the world.

programme.title: Waterworld
programme.desc: Big-budget tale of the battle for survival in a world where dry land has disappeared with the melting of the polar ice caps. One man, who has become amphibious, tries to protect survivors on an artificial atoll made from scrap metal by taking on a gang of marauding pirates. He is also intent on discovering if there is any truth in the myth that there is still some land left above water.

programme.title: Pacific Rim
programme.desc: A ragtag band of humans bands together in the year 2025 to fight legions of monstrous creatures rising from the sea.

programme.title: Arrival
programme.desc: A linguistics professor leads an elite team of investigators in a race against time to communicate with extraterrestrial visitors.

programme.title: Assassin's Creed
programme.desc: Cal Lynch travels back in time to 15th-century Spain through a revolutionary technology that unlocks the genetic memories contained in his DNA. There, he lives out the experiences of Aguilar de Nerha, a distant relative who's also a member of the Assassins, a secret society that fights to protect free will from the power-hungry Templar Order. Transformed by the past, Cal begins to gain the knowledge and physical skills necessary to battle the oppressive organisation in the present.

programme.title: IT
programme.desc: Seven young outcasts in Derry, Maine, are about to face their worst nightmare -- an ancient, shape-shifting evil that emerges from the sewer every 27 years to prey on the town's children. Banding together over the course of one horrifying summer, the friends must overcome their own personal fears to battle the murderous, bloodthirsty clown known as Pennywise.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn 2: Texas Blood Money
programme.desc: A bank robber headed for a Mexican heist stumbles into a bar frequented by the undead, where he's turned into a vampire.

programme.title: 28 Years Later: The Bone Temple
programme.desc: Dr Kelson makes a discovery that could change the world, while Spike's encounter with cult leader Jimmy Crystal becomes a nightmare he can't escape.

programme.title: Nosferatu
programme.desc: A new bride is left under the care of friends when her husband travels to Transylvania for a meeting with Count Orlok. Plagued by horrific visions and an increasing sense of dread, she soon encounters an evil force that's far beyond her control.

programme.title: Anaconda
programme.desc: Filmmaker Terri Flores is travelling deep in the Amazon jungle looking for a forgotten tribe. Terri and her crew, which includes an anthropologist and a cameraman, come across Paul, who is stranded on the riverbank. He offers to help them find the tribe, but his secretive behaviour puts everyone on edge. They realise too late that he's using them to find a legendary anaconda that's worth a fortune, if they can catch it.

programme.title: Assassin's Creed

programme.title: Pitch Black
programme.desc: A deep space transporter crash-lands on a desolate planet circled by three suns. Among the survivors are pilot Carolyn Fry, mystic Abu 'Imam' al-Walid, cop William J Johns and convicted criminal Richard B Riddick, and their first thoughts are of survival and escape. Then Fry finds out that the planet suffers a total eclipse every 22 years, which is when the hibernating, flesh-eating inhabitants awake and hunt.

programme.title: The Chronicles of Riddick
programme.desc: Outlaw Riddick, on the request of the peacemakers, lands on planet New Mecca and comes face to face with the army of Necromongers who are threatening all planets in their path. Their leader, Lord Marshal, wishes to convert all humans to his beliefs, or kill them.

programme.title: Pet Sematary
programme.desc: Dr Louis Creed and his wife, Rachel, relocate from Boston to rural Maine with their two young children. The couple soon discover a mysterious burial ground hidden deep in the woods near their new home. programme.title: 16 December
programme.desc: 16 December 1971 was the day when India won the war against Pakistan and was able to liberate Bangladesh from Pakistan's rule. When the ruling dictator of Pakistan surrendered to India, some of the hard-lined Pakistani soldiers were bitter and angry at the surrender, as they wanted to continue fighting the Indians until their last breath. programme.desc: Chris Packham explores what enables birds of prey to rule the aerial roost. Their ability to dominate their fellow birds in terms of strength, manoeuvrability and speed is down to a combination of anatomical and physiological adaptations.

programme.title: South Pacific
programme.desc: Flightless parrots, burrowing bats, giant skinks and kangaroos in trees - on the isolated islands of the South Pacific, the wildlife has evolved in extraordinary ways. Island living can carry a high price, for when new species arrive, all hell breaks loose. There lies a puzzle: why do animals perfectly adapted to island life simply give up the ghost?

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: The team are in Huddersfield in West Yorkshire, and experts Mark Stacey and Christina Trevanion are on hand to find a selection of objects to take to auction. A beautifully crafted clock catches Christina's eye, while Mark is drawn to an unusual piece of Lalique glass. Meanwhile, Paul Martin pays a visit to Nostell Priory, a grand house that reveals a perfect marriage between Georgian architecture and craftsmanship.

programme.title: House of Games
programme.desc: Richard Osman takes to the host seat for a final week of quizzing before he hands over the baton to a new host next week. He is joined by previous winners Miles Jupp, Cariad Lloyd, Lucy Porter and Kiell Smith-Bynoe, who go head-to-head, testing their general knowledge skills in a variety of fun trivia-based games. A daily winner is declared following a quickfire round at the end of each show, and the scores are tallied across the week, resulting in an overall champion being crowned on Friday.

programme.title: Strictly Come Dancing: It Takes Two
programme.desc: Ellie Taylor dishes up more unmissable backstage gossip and behind-the-scenes action from the world of Strictly as the celebs prepare for their next dances. Also, the five new pros join Ellie in studio for a catch-up.

programme.title: Access All Areas
programme.desc: Sparkles, sequins and shed loads of self-tan. We're behind the scenes at the real Strictly Come Dancing as the British National Dance Championships celebrates its 50th anniversary.

programme.title: Live: Sportscene
programme.desc: Live coverage from the Nations League as Scotland face Switzerland.

programme.title: Colin from Accounts
programme.desc: Ash grapples with Gordon's behaviour at Brett's bucks' party. Lynelle and Lee face some trouble with the law. Colin's misadventure with a bag of raisins brings Ash and Gordon back together where their relationship first began.

programme.title: Newsnight
programme.desc: Featuring extensive coverage of the day's top national and international news stories, along with explanations about the context and potential aftereffects.

programme.title: BBC Weather
programme.desc: The latest weather forecast.

programme.title: Finding Britain's Slave Traders with David Olusoga
programme.desc: David Olusoga explores how ending the royal monopoly sparked a massive surge in the slave trade, spreading to provincial ports as thousands invested.

programme.title: The Split Up
programme.desc: Aria makes a risky play for Kishan Law. Later, a chaotic awards ceremony leaves her stunned to uncover the true nature of Dhruv and Zoya's hidden relationship.

programme.title: Not Going Out
programme.desc: When Lucy's goddaughter has her 20th birthday party in their house, Lee kills the mood by stopping them from playing his precious vinyl.

programme.title: Emergency 24/7
programme.desc: Trainee team leader Matt must organise the response to a man attacked with an iron bar. And the plastics team face painstaking surgery when a carpenter arrives with severed fingers.

programme.title: This Is BBC TWO
programme.desc: A preview of upcoming programmes from BBC Two.

programme.title: Escape to the Country
programme.desc: Jonnie Irwin heads to West Sussex to help a couple in need of a new home in the countryside for a budget of £700,000. During his journey, Jonnie hits the mountain bike trail in England's national park, the South Downs.

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Round two for Margie and Ishy on the Lincolnshire lanes in the Lambo. There are rare chalk streams, cats with bats and giant-sized treasures. But who will chalk up a win?

programme.title: Weatherman Walking
programme.desc: Derek Brockway revisits three wildlife walks. First, he braves the rain in Gwynedd, then hunts for water voles in Radnorshire and finally sees ancient rock formations in Ceredigion.

programme.title: Weatherman Walking
programme.desc: Derek goes island hopping, visiting Caldey off the Pembrokeshire coast, then Anglesey, known for its seabirds, before finishing in south Wales at Barry Island, his childhood home.

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: A comprehensive compilation of the latest and the most important news stories, updates and developments from the UK and different parts of the world.

programme.title: Politics Live
programme.desc: Engaging conversation about the political issues that matter to you.

programme.title: Impossible
programme.desc: Contestants compete across the series, scoring points by answering questions correctly. However, they must avoid the impossible answers, otherwise they will be eliminated from the show until the next day.

programme.title: Unbeatable
programme.desc: Jason Manford hosts the quiz show where players face a question and pick from a board of six rankable answers. Some answers are good, but only one is unbeatable.

programme.title: The Boss
programme.desc: Susan Calman hosts the quiz show where being in control is everything. Who will emerge as the Boss and walk away with the cash? Only the strongest players will survive the game.

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: It's Children's Week in the sewing room, and Sara Pascoe invites the sewers to make a cute sailor suit for a toddler. The task requires them to make elasticated shorts and a top with a square collar and ties. For the Transformation Challenge, the sewers turn old school clothes into a cool outfit to be seen in outside school. Then things get scary when mini-models enter the sewing room for a Halloween-themed Made to Measure.

programme.title: South Pacific
programme.desc: The South Pacific is still relatively healthy and teeming with fish, but it is a fragile paradise. International fishing fleets are taking a serious toll on the sharks, albatross and tuna, and there are other insidious threats to these bountiful seas. This episode looks at what is being done to preserve the ocean and its wildlife.
